description: Skill progression (packages/core/docs/mechanic-predicates.md §6): which skills exist, the cap, the XP curve and the prerequisites — the content around the character block's skill/3 and has_skill/3, which are untouched. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/prolog/mechanics/skill-predicates.ts verbatim. skill_level_xp/3 is the world's CURVE: without it in content the curve is a constant in four engines and the same save levels up in three of them. US-1 of 123-skill-trees-and-progression added the TREE — nodes, prerequisites, costs and effects — and four cases for it: a node whose parent, points and authored goal all hold; one already taken; one whose authored goal belongs to somebody ELSE (the corpus half of the =.. rebuild, since calling the goal as stored would let one guild member's standing unlock the whole roster's node); and skill_effect/2, which is how a node reaches another module without that module knowing what a tree is.

cases.name: learns-a-skill-whose-prerequisite-is-met
kb: skill_capped(A, S) :- has_skill(A, S, L), skill_max_level(S, L).
can_learn_skill(A, S) :- skill_defined(S, _), \+ has_skill(A, S, _), \+ (skill_requires(S, P, Min), \+ (has_skill(A, P, L), L >= Min)).
can_advance(A, S) :- has_skill(A, S, L), \+ skill_capped(A, S), Next is L + 1, skill_level_xp(S, Next, Need), skill_xp(A, S, X), X >= Need.
skill_goal_met(A, Goal) :- Goal =.. [F, _ | Rest], Bound =.. [F, A | Rest], call(Bound).
skill_points_held(A, T, P) :- skill_points(A, T, P), !.
can_unlock(A, N) :- skill_node(N, T), \+ skill_unlocked(A, N), skill_node_price(N, C), skill_points_held(A, T, P), P >= C, \+ (skill_node_requires(N, G), \+ skill_goal_met(A, G)).
skill_effect(A, E) :- skill_unlocked(A, N), skill_node_effect(N, E).
